template:
# 1. Keep the RSVP function's logs for 30 days, then let them expire
aws logs {{0}} \
  --log-group-name /aws/lambda/lantern-rsvp --retention-in-days 30

# 2. Email the maintainers when the function errors 5+ times in 5 minutes
aws cloudwatch {{1}} --alarm-name lantern-rsvp-errors \
  --namespace AWS/Lambda --metric-name {{2}} \
  --dimensions Name=FunctionName,Value=lantern-rsvp \
  --statistic Sum --period 300 --evaluation-periods 1 \
  --threshold 5 --comparison-operator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold \
  --alarm-actions arn:aws:{{3}}:eu-west-1:111122223333:lantern-alerts
